items.summary: Port covers only the cudaCoord (CUDA/Thrust/CUB) plugin. Excluded GPU surfaces: openaccPTM plugin (NVIDIA OpenACC offload via nvc++, the USEGPU path) -- no production ROCm OpenACC analogue; SAXS ArrayFire-CUDA backend (ArrayFire OpenCL could target AMD); core OpenACC infra (src/tools/OpenACC.h) and the libtorch-CUDA pytorch module. All opt-in/default-off. RULING SCOPE (jeffdaily 2026-08-13): pursue the feasible opt-in surfaces (SAXS via ArrayFire-OpenCL, libtorch module); OpenACC surfaces wait for a production ROCm OpenACC analogue.

plugins/cudaCoord/conda.mk builds conda packages only for CUDA (mutually exclusive cuda-coordination variants); there is no ROCm/HIP package variant. Ruled defer by jeffdaily 2026-11-18: conda packaging for ROCm is not part of the current port.
